page_title: Contexts - Radically simpler & faster window switcher for Mac

sources.entry: contexts - App switcher for faster window and app switching across multiple screens.

summary.name: Contexts
summary.one_liner: Contexts is a macOS window switcher that lets you find and switch to app windows via search, a better Command-Tab, and a Fast Search shortcut.
use_cases: Switch quickly to a specific app window on a Mac
Find a window by typing part of its title
Replace the default Command-Tab with a per-window list
Close, quit, minimize or hide several windows quickly
Filter windows by macOS Space or full-screen state
summary.what_it_does: Contexts opens a Search window (Control-Space by default, configurable) where typing a few non-consecutive characters from an app name or window title filters the list, and Return switches to the selected item. Acronym-style matches and saved search shortcuts make frequently used windows the first result. Fast Search lets you hold Fn (or another chosen modifier) while typing a short query and release to bring the window forward. It also provides a Command-Tab switcher that lists windows separately, plus Command-Backquote to cycle windows of the frontmost app. Multiple switcher configurations and Space filtering are supported.
notable: Fast Search with modifier-key plus short query, e.g. Fn-s to switch to Safari
Search shortcuts remember your chosen window for a query
Separate left and right modifier key support
Multiple switcher configurations, e.g. one for Command-Tab and one for Option-Tab
caveats: Page mentions a free trial, but the paid terms are not stated in the page text
Works on macOS Ventura, Sonoma and Sequoia only, as listed
